item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 16/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine with rather cool mornings over the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. It will be cold over inland areas, with a rather large temperature difference between day and night. With the northeast monsoon moderating slightly early next week, temperatures will rise progressively over the coast of Guangdong. An easterly airstream is expected to affect the coastal areas midweek next week. It will be slightly cloudier over the region.
